features: HYBRID ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION: Advanced Hybrid ANC up to 48dB helps reduce surrounding noise so you can enjoy music, calls, and entertainment with better clarity.

LONG BATTERY LIFE: Built with a 1000mAh battery delivering up to 100hrs* of playback (*at 80% volume with ANC off), along with rapid charging that provides 10 hours of use with just 10 minutes of charge*.
POWERFUL AUDIO PERFORMANCE: Equipped with 40mm neodymium drivers that deliver rich bass, clear vocals, and balanced sound for an immersive listening experience.
CRYSTAL CLEAR CALLS: Dual microphone Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) helps reduce background noise for clearer voice calls.
LOW LATENCY GAMING MODE: Gaming mode minimizes audio delay, ensuring better synchronization between sound and visuals while gaming.
